proposed_action: Issue automatic refunds to all customers affected by a billing error in the last 30 days.
raw_reasoning:
Option A: This action directly affects customers by changing their financial balance and correcting a billing error via refunds. Customers would reasonably expect that refunds are handled for their benefit, but whether they should be asked first depends on whether the error is confirmed and refunds are automatic without additional processing that could be disputed. Since the proposal says to refund all affected customers, it resembles a corrective remedy that typically does not require prior user consent.
